concept.title: Frequently asked questions
concept.shortdesc: Quick answers to the questions shelters ask most about .

section.title: Is our data safe?
section.p: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, backed up every hour, and stored in the region you chose at sign-up. never sells or shares shelter data.

section.title: Can we import records from our old system?
section.p: Yes. During onboarding, our team imports animals, people and medical history from a CSV export or directly from most common shelter systems, at no charge.

section.title: Does it work without internet?
section.p: The web app needs a connection. The app works offline for everyday kennel tasks and syncs when it reconnects.

section.title: Why can't I see adopter phone numbers?
section.p: Your role doesn't include access to adopter contact details. See , or ask your administrator.

section.title: Something isn't working. What should I do?
section.p: Try signing out and back in. If the problem continues, note what you were doing and when, then contact support.
